assertions.text: Response uses GitHub's native sub-issues API, not a 'Related: #N' prose comment
Response uses the plural REST path repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<number>/sub_issues, not the singular sub_issue
Response correctly identifies sub_issue_id must be the target issue's internal numeric id (fetched via gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<target-number> --jq '.id'), not its visible number
